# HostelPulse — llms.txt

> HostelPulse is Nigeria's first AI-powered student housing and property marketplace, built specifically for LAUTECH students and residents of Ogbomoso, Oyo State, Nigeria.

## What is HostelPulse?

HostelPulse (https://hostelpulse.app) is a trusted property platform designed to eliminate the stress of finding hostels, shortlets, shops, and land in Ogbomoso. It connects students, buyers, renters, agents, and landlords in a secure, verified marketplace.

Key differentiators:
- Verified listings with walkthroughs and real photos
- Secure escrow payment system (no paying landlords directly)
- LAUTECH-focused (Ladoke Akintola University of Technology, Ogbomoso)
- Roommate matching for students
- Campus marketplace and gig board
- Trusted agent and landlord verification system

## Services Offered

- **Hostel Rentals** — Monthly and yearly hostel rooms near LAUTECH
- **Shortlet Apartments** — Daily and weekly stays in Ogbomoso
- **Properties for Sale** — Land, houses, and commercial plots in Ogbomoso
- **Shop & Commercial Space** — Shops in Takie, General Market, and other areas
- **Campus Marketplace** — Students buy and sell items securely
- **Campus Gigs** — Students find and offer campus services
- **Roommate Finder** — Students find compatible roommates

## Key Areas Served

Ogbomoso North and South, including:
- Under-G (Under-Graduate area)
- Adenike
- Aroje
- Takie
- General Market area
- Surulere

## Trust & Safety

HostelPulse uses an escrow system for all payments. Users should NEVER pay a landlord directly — all payments go through the platform for security. Agents and landlords are identity-verified before listing.

Verification tiers:
- Unverified (new providers)
- Verified (identity confirmed)
- Verified by HostelPulse (fully vetted and endorsed)

## Target Users

- LAUTECH students seeking affordable accommodation
- Non-student residents of Ogbomoso
- Agents listing properties for landlords
- Landlords managing their own listings
- Buyers seeking property in Ogbomoso

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is HostelPulse only for LAUTECH students?**
A: No. HostelPulse serves all residents and buyers in Ogbomoso, including non-students. However, students get additional features like roommate matching and campus marketplace access.

**Q: How safe is paying on HostelPulse?**
A: All payments go through a secure escrow system. Funds are only released to landlords/agents after the tenant confirms receipt.

**Q: How do I list a property on HostelPulse?**
A: Sign up as an Agent or Landlord at https://hostelpulse.app/join, complete identity verification, and use the Listing Studio to add your property.

**Q: Can I find hostel near LAUTECH on HostelPulse?**
A: Yes. Search at https://hostelpulse.app/rent for verified hostels close to LAUTECH with prices, photos, and walkthroughs.

**Q: What is the cheapest hostel near LAUTECH?**
A: HostelPulse lists hostels at various price points. Prices vary by location, room type (self-con, shared, ensuite), and proximity to campus. Visit https://hostelpulse.app/rent for current listings.

**Q: Does HostelPulse have shortlets in Ogbomoso?**
A: Yes. Visit https://hostelpulse.app/shortlet for daily and weekly stays in Ogbomoso.
